headline: We have a winner
body:
Oliver Record Completes the Perfect Season: 12 Wins from 12 in Project Motor Racing MX-5 League of what he has participated in to date

There are championship-winning seasons, and then there are seasons that become part of league folklore.

The 2026 Project Motor Racing MX-5 League belonged to one driver from lights out at Round 1 until the chequered flag of the finale: Oliver Record.

In a display of consistency rarely seen in sim racing, Record completed the season with an astonishing 12 victories from 12 races, remaining unbeaten throughout the championship. As if that wasn't enough, he also recorded the fastest lap in every single race, leaving no statistical category untouched.

Across every circuit, the story remained the same. While rivals battled fiercely behind him, Record combined outright pace with clinical racecraft, avoiding costly mistakes and executing every weekend with the precision of a factory driver. Whether qualifying, managing tyres, defending under pressure or building race-winning gaps, he consistently found another level when it mattered.

The numbers are almost difficult to comprehend:

🏆 12 Races
🥇 12 Victories
⚡ 12 Fastest Laps
💯 100% Win Rate
👑 2026 Project Motor Racing MX-5 League Champion

Dominance is a word often overused in motorsport, but in this case it barely does the achievement justice. Winning a championship requires speed. Winning every race requires perfection.

Driving in his iconic Gulf Racing colours, Record became the benchmark for the entire field. Week after week, competitors searched for answers, but none could consistently match his relentless pace. Every round presented new challenges, yet every weekend ended with the same result: Oliver Record standing on the top step.

League organisers and fellow drivers have already begun describing the campaign as one of the greatest individual seasons the MX-5 League has ever witnessed. Completing a perfect season while also setting every fastest lap is an achievement few drivers at any level of motorsport—real or virtual—can claim.

For everyone else, 2026 was a season spent chasing.

For Oliver Record, it was a season spent making history.

Congratulations to the 2026 Project Motor Racing MX-5 League Champion. An undefeated season. Twelve from twelve. Absolute perfection. Wins the league with 4 races to go
